convertedTotal.noTotal: No total — today’s rates could not be loaded
convertedTotal.ratesUnavailable: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — today’s rates could not be loaded, so this figure is incomplete.

convertedFigure.unavailableSpokenMany_one: {{count}} currency not converted — today’s rates could not be loaded
convertedFigure.unavailableSpokenMany_other: {{count}} currencies not converted — today’s rates could not be loaded
convertedFigure.unconvertedSpokenMany_one: {{count}} currency not converted — no recent rate
convertedFigure.unconvertedSpokenMany_other: {{count}} currencies not converted — no recent rate

notFound.title: This page doesn’t exist
notFound.body: Nothing in Scani is at the address you asked for. The link may be out of date, or the address may have a typo in it.

empty.title: Nothing tracked yet
empty.body: A screenshot of a balance screen is enough — from an exchange, a bank or a broker. A CSV or statement export works too, and there is nothing to log into.

importing.title: An import is running
importing.body: We are reading the holdings out of it. You can leave this screen — it keeps going, and this page fills in once it lands.

allocation.title: Allocation
allocation.empty: Nothing priced under this cut yet.

upcoming.title: Upcoming bills
upcoming.empty_one: Nothing due in the next {{count}} day.
upcoming.empty_other: Nothing due in the next {{count}} days.

hero.chartFailed: The chart could not be loaded. Your figures above are the last ones we had.
hero.changeUnavailable: Couldn't load the change for this period
hero.changePending: Working out the change for this period
hero.pnlNotComputed: PnL is not computed for this period yet
hero.noHistory: No history for this period yet
hero.noMeasurementSince: No measurement since {{date}} — the last point is today's live total, not a rolled-up day.

quality.noBasis_one: {{count}} no cost basis (gain is an upper bound)
quality.noBasis_other: {{count}} no cost basis (gain is an upper bound)

historyExport.emptyBody: There is no measured history in that window yet.
historyExport.subject: Net worth history

upcoming.noneAhead_one: Nothing due in the next {{count}} day.
upcoming.noneAhead_other: Nothing due in the next {{count}} days.
upcoming.estimatedExcluded_one: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} bill is estimated from its last settled amount, and an estimate is not a commitment.
upcoming.estimatedExcluded_other: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} bills are estimated from their last settled amounts, and an estimate is not a commitment.
upcoming.estimatedExcludedOverdue_one: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} overdue bill is estimated from its last settled amount, and its real amount is still unknown.
upcoming.estimatedExcludedOverdue_other: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} overdue bills are estimated from their last settled amounts, and their real amounts are still unknown.
upcoming.label: upcoming payments

endPayment.base: Ends {{vendor}} on {{date}}. It stops appearing in Upcoming, and its paid and skipped history is kept.
endPayment.checking: Checking how many scheduled dates this removes…
endPayment.noneRemoved: There are no scheduled dates after that to remove.
endPayment.removed_one: {{count}} scheduled date after that is removed. This cannot be undone — reviving an ended payment is not something Scani can do.
endPayment.removed_other: {{count}} scheduled dates after that are removed. This cannot be undone — reviving an ended payment is not something Scani can do.

deletePayment.checking: Deletes the {{vendor}} payment. Checking what it has against it…
deletePayment.blocked_one: This payment has {{count}} date settled against it — money that really moved. It cannot be deleted, because that would erase the history too.
deletePayment.blocked_other: This payment has {{count}} dates settled against it — money that really moved. It cannot be deleted, because that would erase the history too.
deletePayment.wayOutEnded: It has already ended, so the schedule is stopped and the record stays.
deletePayment.wayOutEnd: End it instead: the schedule stops and the record stays.
deletePayment.lead: Deletes the {{vendor}} payment as if it had never existed.
deletePayment.tail: It leaves Upcoming, the totals and this list. Use End instead if this bill really ran — that keeps the record. This cannot be undone.

deleteVendor.checking: Deletes "{{vendor}}". Checking what points at it…
deleteVendor.blocked_one: "{{vendor}}" still has {{count}} payment pointing at it, and deleting it would take that payment and everything settled against it. End or delete it first, or merge "{{vendor}}" into the vendor you meant.
deleteVendor.blocked_other: "{{vendor}}" still has {{count}} payments pointing at it, and deleting it would take those payments and everything settled against them. End or delete them first, or merge "{{vendor}}" into the vendor you meant.
deleteVendor.lead: Deletes "{{vendor}}". Nothing is paid to or by it.
deleteVendor.alsoAliases_one: {{count}} alias it has been seen under goes with it
deleteVendor.alsoAliases_other: {{count}} aliases it has been seen under go with it
deleteVendor.alsoExtractions_one: {{count}} parsed invoice keeps its own record but loses its link to this vendor
deleteVendor.alsoExtractions_other: {{count}} parsed invoices keep their own records but lose their link to this vendor

mergeVendor.nothingMoves: Nothing points at "{{duplicate}}", so nothing moves. This cannot be undone.
mergeVendor.moves_one: {{clauses}} moves to "{{survivor}}". This cannot be undone.
mergeVendor.moves_other: {{clauses}} move to "{{survivor}}". This cannot be undone.
mergeVendor.pickOne: Pick a duplicate to fold into "{{vendor}}". It keeps this record; the one you pick is deleted.
mergeVendor.noCandidates: There is no other vendor to merge in

paymentForm.intro: A bill or recurring income, matched against transactions as they arrive.
paymentForm.cadenceCaveat: One invoice can't prove how often it repeats — check the schedule before saving.
paymentForm.extractionGone: That invoice is no longer awaiting review, so nothing could be prefilled. Fill the form in yourself, or reopen the document from Review.
paymentForm.missingBody: It may have been ended and removed, or the link may be out of date.
paymentForm.amountIsVariableHint: The real figure is set when you settle each one.
paymentForm.anchorFromIssueDate: The invoice states no due date — this is its issue date.
paymentForm.anchorMissing: No date found on the invoice. Pick the day this is due.
paymentForm.markPaidHint: Marks the period it covers as settled, so the one you'll see coming up is the next payment, not this one.
paymentForm.notesPlaceholder: Anything worth remembering about this payment
paymentForm.repeatNoUnit: One invoice never proves a cadence — say how often this bill arrives.
paymentForm.repeatWeek_one: Repeats every week, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatWeek_other: Repeats every {{count}} weeks, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatMonth_one: Repeats every month, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatMonth_other: Repeats every {{count}} months, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatQuarter_one: Repeats every quarter, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatQuarter_other: Repeats every {{count}} quarters, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatYear_one: Repeats every year, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.repeatYear_other: Repeats every {{count}} years, anchored on the day it's due.
paymentForm.estimateFromHistory: Estimate from what it last cost
paymentForm.estimateFromHistoryHint: Off by default. When on, forecasts use the amount you last settled for this payment, and say which month it came from.

status.pauseConsequence: No new due dates while paused. Anything that falls due meanwhile is recorded as skipped, not overdue.
status.resumeConsequence: Picks up the original schedule — the same dates as before. Past due dates are left exactly as they are.
status.resumeConsequenceSince: Picks up the original schedule — the same dates as before. Anything due since {{date}} is recorded as skipped, not overdue.

vendorSpend.notSubtracted: Not subtracted from what you owe — these are two separate figures.

vendorField.label: Vendor
vendorField.pendingHint: Read from the invoice. We'll create this vendor when you save if it doesn't exist yet.
vendorField.empty: No vendor by that name yet.
vendorField.typeToCreate: Type a name to create a vendor
vendorField.similarNames_one: Already have a vendor with a similar name:
vendorField.similarNames_other: Already have vendors with a similar name:

currencyField.label: Currency
currencyField.empty: Nothing in your token list matches that.

duplicatePicker.intro: Pick the duplicate to delete. It is folded into <survivor>{{vendor}}</survivor>, which is kept.

expectedIncome.caption_one: What you expect to receive. Not counted against the {{count}}-day bill figure above.
expectedIncome.caption_other: What you expect to receive. Not counted against the {{count}}-day bill figure above.
expectedIncome.estimatedExcluded_one: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} payment is estimated from its last settled amount, and a past amount is not a forecast.
expectedIncome.estimatedExcluded_other: Not included: <amounts></amounts> — {{count}} payments are estimated from their last settled amounts, and a past amount is not a forecast.

recurringSummary.estimatedFromHistory_one: Includes {{count}} variable payment estimated from its last settled amount.
recurringSummary.estimatedFromHistory_other: Includes {{count}} variable payments estimated from their last settled amounts.
recurringSummary.notCounted_one: {{count}} variable payment has no estimate and is not counted.
recurringSummary.notCounted_other: {{count}} variable payments have no estimate and are not counted.

vendorPeek.unclassified: This vendor’s payments do not say whether the money goes out or comes in, so no monthly figure is shown.

blocker.estimateAboveZero: make the estimate more than zero, or clear it
blocker.pickCurrency: pick a currency from the list

forecast.label: cashflow forecast
forecast.basisIlliquid_one: <value></value> in {{count}} property or private position is left out as illiquid.
forecast.basisIlliquid_other: <value></value> across {{count}} property and private positions is left out as illiquid.
forecast.basisUnpriceable_one: {{count}} holding has no price and is not counted.
forecast.basisUnpriceable_other: {{count}} holdings have no price and are not counted.
forecast.chartLabel_one: Projected balance over the next {{count}} month
forecast.chartLabel_other: Projected balance over the next {{count}} months
forecast.unprojectable_one: {{count}} variable payment has no estimate, so nothing was projected for it.
forecast.unprojectable_other: {{count}} variable payments have no estimate, so nothing was projected for them.
forecast.overdueExcluded_one: {{count}} bill is already overdue and is not in the series.
forecast.overdueExcluded_other: {{count}} bills are already overdue and are not in the series.
forecast.affordStaysPositive: The balance stays above zero for the whole window.
forecast.affordGoesNegative: The balance goes below zero at that point.
forecast.affordRunwayAfter: After it, the money runs out in {{month}}.
forecast.projectedNote: Your recurring book alone — what is scheduled, and when. It does not describe what you spend.
forecast.observedBasis: Mean of {{count}} complete months, {{from}} to {{to}}: <value></value> a month.
forecast.observedSpread: Those months ranged <min></min> to <max></max>; the middle month was <median></median>.
forecast.observedNotCounted_one: {{count}} outflow is not counted — unanswered, or moved somewhere Scani cannot see.
forecast.observedNotCounted_other: {{count}} outflows are not counted — unanswered, or moved somewhere Scani cannot see.
forecast.affordCannot: That is more than the liquid balance.
forecast.affordNoSchedule: Measured against your average rate, so it cannot tell a purchase now from one later in the year.
forecast.provenanceTitle: Who classified the money that IS counted
forecast.provenanceUser: {{percent}}% of that value rests on answers you gave.
forecast.provenanceAutomated: {{percent}}% was decided by a named rule you can go and read.
forecast.provenanceUnattributed: {{percent}}% carries no record of who or what decided.
forecast.answerAmountLabel: What you actually spend a month
forecast.answerConfirmedMoved: You confirmed <was/> on {{date}}. It is now <now/>.
forecast.answerOverrideActive: Using your figure of <amount/> a month, set on {{date}}. Measured: <measured/>.
forecast.answerRevert: Go back to the measured figure
forecast.answerCurrencyChanged: Your answer from {{date}} was given in a different currency, so it no longer applies.
forecast.estimatedCount_one: {{count}} variable payment is priced from its last settled amount, not from an estimate anybody entered.
forecast.estimatedCount_other: {{count}} variable payments are priced from their last settled amount, not from an estimate anybody entered.
forecast.couldEstimate_one: {{count}} of those variable payments has settled before, so its last amount could stand in.
forecast.couldEstimate_other: {{count}} of those variable payments have settled before, so their last amounts could stand in.

coverage.empty: Nothing in this group carries a value today.
coverage.counted_one: What the {{count}} holding behind this total is worth today.
coverage.counted_other: What the {{count}} holdings behind this total are worth today.
coverage.countedOf_one: Covers {{count}} of the {{listed}} holdings listed below.
coverage.countedOf_other: Covers {{count}} of the {{listed}} holdings listed below.

groups.accountNote: An account here brings everything it holds and anything it receives later. A holding counted by both is still counted once.
groups.inactiveNote_one: {{count}} of them is inactive: it stays in the group and is listed below, but it is not in this total.
groups.inactiveNote_other: {{count}} of them are inactive: they stay in the group and are listed below, but they are not in this total.

unpriced.note_one: {{named}} could not be priced today, so it is not in this total.
unpriced.note_other: {{named}} could not be priced today, so they are not in this total.

assign.title: Assign groups
assign.description: Every group ticked here is applied to {{entities}}. A group they do not all already share is not on the list, and is left alone.
assign.stillLoading: wait for the groups to load
assign.firstDescription: You have no groups yet. This one is created and applied to {{entities}}.
assign.subject: these groups

detail.notFound: This group is not on your list. It may have been deleted, or the link may be out of date.
detail.note: Adding a whole account keeps it in the group — including whatever it receives later. Take single holdings out from the list above.
detail.empty: Nothing is in this group yet. Add a holding or an account and it will show up here.
detail.name: Name
detail.needName: To save: give the group a name.
detail.deleteConsequence: “{{name}}” disappears from every list and filter. The {{members}} in it are not deleted — they simply stop carrying this label.

outcome.unpriced: No price could be found for this, so no gain was booked. The cost is still shown.
outcome.unreviewed: Waiting on your answer, so no gain was booked either way.
outcome.retained: You said this never left your control, so nothing was realized.
outcome.awaitingPair: Only one side of this move was imported, so no gain was booked.
outcome.realizedUnattributed: Recorded as having left your portfolio, so this gain was booked. There is no record of anyone answering it — the answer was not given in the review queue.
outcome.retainedUnattributed: Recorded as never having left your control, so nothing was realized. There is no record of anyone answering it.
outcome.fee: A charge taken out of what left, so no gain was booked — it is counted as a cost, not as a withdrawal.

basis.partialNote: Based on history we know is incomplete or a price outside our freshness window.
basis.unknownNote: We have no record of acquiring this, so the whole amount shows as gain. Most often that is an import that could not fetch far enough back.

valuation.heldTokenFallback: Valued from the token that left, at its price on the day: what came back has no price history, so the rate this swap executed at could not be converted.
valuation.estimatedLabel: Valued from the token that left

amountFact.belowZero: Below zero — nothing you can enter produces this. It happens when an undone transfer crosses a balance that changed after it. Set it to the right figure.

deleteAction.consequence: {{symbol}} in {{account}} is removed, along with every transaction recorded against it — <value/> comes off your portfolio total. Nothing restores it; a re-import would have to rebuild the history. To take it out of the total and keep the record, use Deactivate.

payout.yearlyLastDay: Yearly on the last day of {{month}}

peek.unpriceableNote: No source has ever quoted this token, and we have stopped asking for now. It is left out of your net worth rather than counted as zero.
peek.incompleteHistory: Incomplete — inflows from before the first imported transaction are missing, so values before that date are clamped.
peek.predatesEarliestStatement: Predates the earliest available statement (from {{date}}) — money that moved before then was never fetched, so no transaction here can account for it. Import a statement covering the earlier period to close it.

badge.noPriceTitle: No price source has ever quoted this token, and we have stopped asking for now. It is left out of your net worth rather than counted as zero.
badge.lookalikeTitle: This token's symbol is written with characters that draw "{{impersonates}}" without being it. The row is kept, and your balance with it, because hiding it would tell you nothing — but it is not the token it resembles.

bulk.deleteConsequence_one: {{symbols}} is removed from your portfolio, and every transaction recorded against it goes too. This cannot be undone.
bulk.deleteConsequence_other: {{symbols}} are removed from your portfolio, and every transaction recorded against them goes too. This cannot be undone.

apy.consequence: Interest will stop accruing on this holding. Payouts already recorded are kept.
apy.description: Interest is added to this holding’s balance on every payout date, and recorded there as a transaction you can see in its history.
apy.subject: the interest configuration
apy.needRate: enter an annual rate above 0 and no more than 100
apy.needDayOfMonth: enter a day of the month between 1 and 31
apy.shortMonths: Shorter months pay on their last day.
apy.pastMonthEnd: {{month}} ends before that, so this pays on its last day.
apy.preview: {{schedule}}. At today’s balance the next payout is about {{amount}} {{symbol}}.
apy.editRestarts: Saving restarts the schedule from today — the next payout is the first matching date from now.

refresh.partial_one: {{symbol}} wasn't returned by the provider — your other {{count}} balance refreshed. Try again in a minute, or re-import the account if this keeps happening.
refresh.partial_other: {{symbol}} wasn't returned by the provider — your other {{count}} balances refreshed. Try again in a minute, or re-import the account if this keeps happening.
refresh.exited: {{symbol}} has left this wallet — the chain says 0, so the balance on screen is now 0.

outcome.noPrice: No provider had a price for {{symbol}}. The figure on screen is unchanged.
outcome.storedWithAge: No new price for {{symbol}} — showing the one from {{age}}
outcome.stored: No new price for {{symbol}} — the stored one is unchanged

summary.excludes_one: Excludes {{count}} inactive holding worth <value/>, still listed below.
summary.excludes_other: Excludes {{count}} inactive holdings worth <value/>, still listed below.

status.deactivateConsequence: {{symbol}} in {{account}} stops counting toward your portfolio total — <value/> comes off it. The holding and its history stay, listed here as Inactive, so you can turn it back on.
status.activateConsequence: {{symbol}} in {{account}} counts toward your portfolio total again — <value/> goes back on it.

editCause.title: What did that change mean?
editCause.description: The balance of {{holding}} moved. Scani cannot tell money moving from a figure being fixed from a balance growing, and each one is treated differently.

explain.flow: You added or withdrew money. It counts as a contribution, not as a gain.
explain.correction: The previous figure was wrong. Scani restates the history it covered instead of recording anything happening now.
explain.growth: Interest, a payout or a revaluation. This is the return, and it is the only way Scani can see it on a balance you keep by hand.

destinationExplain.internal: It moved to another holding you track. Pick where, and Scani links the two sides so the cost basis carries across instead of being realized here and reopened there.
destinationExplain.left_control: Spent, gifted, or sold somewhere Scani cannot see. This realizes a gain or a loss on the amount that left.
destinationExplain.untracked: Still your money, in a wallet or an account Scani has no access to. Nothing is realized.

fee.label: Fee, if the transfer cost anything
fee.explain: Leave empty if nothing was charged. A fee is recorded as its own cost on this account, so what arrives is what actually landed.
fee.arrives: {{amount}} {{symbol}} arrives; the fee is recorded as a cost here.
fee.tooLarge: The fee has to be smaller than the amount that moved.

movement.title: Record a movement
movement.description: Say what you did and Scani works out the balance — instead of the other way round.

left_control.title: Spent, sold or given away
left_control.detail: It left your portfolio, so any gain on it is realized.

untracked.title: Moved somewhere Scani cannot see
untracked.detail: Still your money — a cold wallet, an account with no connection. Nothing is realized.

transfer.title: Transferred to another account I hold
transfer.detail: Scani records both sides and links them, so nothing is asked about it later.

blocker.fee: the fee has to be smaller than the amount that moved

column.holdingsStalePriced: Holdings priced from a stale quote

provenance.subject: Whole account
provenance.notIncludedValue: Exchange and brokerage credentials, sessions, uploaded file contents

account.deleteIntro: Deleting your data removes every account, holding, wallet, integration credential, group and vault. The login itself stays, empty.
account.deleteConsequence: Every account, holding, wallet, integration credential, group and vault goes. Your login remains, with nothing in it. This cannot be undone.
account.deleted: All your data has been deleted

export.title: Your data
export.subject: whole account
export.workbookDetail: One sheet per set — holdings, transactions, payments, history
export.jsonDetail: Every field, exactly as the API returns it
export.intro: Every record on this account in one file — holdings, the whole transaction ledger, payments, groups, vaults and your net-worth history. Exchange and brokerage keys are left out: they are credentials, not records.

maintenance.title: Portfolio history
maintenance.intro: Rebuilds the cached daily values the Net worth and PnL charts are drawn from — the same 365-day backfill that runs nightly.

notifications.title: Payment reminders
notifications.intro: A single notification on this device at around 5PM, the day before payments are due — how many, and what they add up to. Nothing is sent on a day with nothing due.
notifications.ready: Reminders are off on this device.
notifications.enabled: Reminders are on for this device.
notifications.denied: This browser is blocking notifications for Scani. Allow them in your browser or system settings, then come back.
notifications.iosNeedsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only reach Scani once it is added to the Home Screen. Open the Share menu and choose Add to Home Screen, then turn them on from there.
notifications.serverUnconfigured: This server has no notification keys set, so it cannot send reminders yet.
notifications.testNoDevices: No device is subscribed yet, so there was nothing to send to.
notifications.testSentHere: Sent to this device. It should appear within a few seconds — if it does not, check that notifications are allowed for Scani in your device settings.
notifications.testSentOther: Sent to another device you have turned reminders on for.
notifications.testGoneHere: This device's subscription had expired, so it has been removed. Turn reminders off and back on here to register a new one.
notifications.testGoneOther: Another device had an expired subscription, so it has been removed. Turn reminders on again on that device.
notifications.testVapidMismatch: The push service rejected this notification (403). The key this device subscribed with is not the key the server signs with, so no reminder can reach it until that is fixed. This one is ours, not yours.
notifications.testFailed: The push service refused this notification (HTTP {{statusCode}}). The subscription is still registered.
notifications.testFailedNoCode: The push service could not be reached. The subscription is still registered.

profile.emailImmutable: Changing this is not something the app can do yet.
profile.baseCurrencyHint: Every figure in the app is converted into this.

sessions.title: Devices
sessions.subject: your devices
sessions.intro: Everywhere this account is currently signed in. End any you do not recognise.
sessions.signOutOthersConsequence_one: Every device except this one is signed out — {{count}} session, including any you do recognise. Each has to sign in again with a new code from your email. Your data is untouched.
sessions.signOutOthersConsequence_other: Every device except this one is signed out — {{count}} sessions, including any you do recognise. Each has to sign in again with a new code from your email. Your data is untouched.
sessions.revokeConsequence: {{device}} at {{where}} is signed out and has to sign in again with a new code from your email. Your data is untouched, and nothing else is signed out.
sessions.currentDevice: This is the device you are using — sign out below instead

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.duplicateRows: Shown positions sharing a symbol with another token row
dataQuality.lookalikeRows: Shown positions whose symbol imitates another
dataQuality.hiddenNextSweep_one: Of those, hidden on the next {{count}}-day sweep
dataQuality.hiddenNextSweep_other: Of those, hidden on the next {{count}}-day sweep
dataQuality.noRecentPrice: Shown positions with no recent price
dataQuality.noPriceSource: Shown positions missing a price source we can use
dataQuality.nothingCanPriceHint: Airdropped or delisted tokens with no market — excluded from chart coverage
dataQuality.negativeOpeningHint: An import that did not reach back before the first trade
dataQuality.intro: Recounted on every visit. Anything marked “{{flag}}” is worth looking into.

stale.notice: Couldn't reach Scani. These are the last figures we had, not today's.

item.unpairedTransfers_one: {{count}} transfer out with no matching deposit
item.unpairedTransfers_other: {{count}} transfers out with no matching deposit

list.valueAwaitingUnpriced_one: <label>Value awaiting an answer:</label> <value/><label>, and {{count}} more with no price that day</label>
list.valueAwaitingUnpriced_other: <label>Value awaiting an answer:</label> <value/><label>, and {{count}} more with no price that day</label>

field.toOwnWallet: A wallet you added — this money stayed in your portfolio

source.unrecordedLong: Not recorded — this answer was not given in the queue
source.ruleNoteUnnamed: Answered by a rule you wrote about this destination

reopen.commit: Put it back in the queue
reopen.declaredCommit: Undo it and put the balances back

toast.reopened: Back in the queue — answer it again there
toast.reopenFailed: That transfer could not be reopened
toast.undone: Transfer undone — both balances are back where they were

decision.noCandidates: No deposit of {{symbol}} landed anywhere in Scani within a week of this, at a comparable amount. If it went somewhere Scani cannot see, say so below.
decision.noLinkTarget: No deposit close enough to link this to

toast.paired: Linked — the cost basis moves with it
toast.internal: Recorded — the deposit is on the other side now
toast.split: Recorded — each part on its own terms
toast.gone: That transfer is no longer waiting

decision.ownWalletNotice: This went to a wallet you added, so the money is still yours. Pair it with the matching deposit, or record where it moved to — choosing that it left your portfolio books it as a sale.
decision.withdrawnNotice: Scani withdrew an earlier answer on this transfer. It was given about a pairing we have since shown was not a transfer at all, so the question is back — and there may be no deposit here to point at.
decision.withdrawnRuleNotice: You took back the answer your rule gave this transfer, so it is back here for you to answer yourself. The rule will not answer it again.

destinationPicker.noDestinations: You have no other account to move this to. If it went somewhere Scani cannot see, say that instead.

transfer.unreviewedBehaviour: While these are unanswered, Scani books no gain on them — moving your own coins is not a sale, and guessing that it was is how an invented gain gets onto your chart. If one of these really did leave your portfolio, its gain is missing from your realized total until you say so.
transfer.unreviewedNote: Unanswered, this books no gain either way.

candidateReason.ambiguous: Matches — but so does another deposit
candidateReason.time: Outside the {{window}} window we match on

hint.ownWallet: Went to a wallet you added

consequence.paired: The {{quantity}} {{symbol}} keeps what you originally paid for it as it moves to {{location}}. Nothing is realized here, and no gain is booked.
consequence.pairedPrompt: Pick the deposit this money arrived in.
consequence.internalPrompt: Pick the holding this money moved to.
consequence.leftControlPriced: Counted as a disposal on {{date}} at market value — about {{amount}} of proceeds against what you paid.
consequence.leftControlUnpriced: Counted as a disposal on {{date}} at market value. Scani has no price for {{symbol}} that day, so nothing is booked.
consequence.untracked: Still yours, just somewhere Scani cannot see. Not a disposal, so no gain is booked — the {{symbol}} simply stops being counted.
consequence.fee: A charge taken out of what left — the bank, the network or the exchange kept it. Not a disposal, so no gain is booked, and the {{symbol}} is counted as a cost rather than as money you took out.

fee.trigger: Part of it was a fee

destination.willCreate: No {{symbol}} tracked here yet — a holding will be created

internal.carry: The {{amount}} {{symbol}} keeps what you originally paid for it as it moves to {{location}}. Nothing is realized, and no gain is booked.
internal.writeNew: A new {{symbol}} holding is created there with a balance of {{amount}} {{symbol}}, holding a deposit dated {{date}}.
internal.writeNewSynced: A new {{symbol}} holding is created there, opening at zero and holding a deposit dated {{date}}. That account is synced, so its next sync fills in the real balance.
internal.writeExisting: A deposit of {{amount}} {{symbol}} dated {{date}} is recorded there. Its balance stays at {{balance}} — that account is synced, so its own sync already reports the money as arrived.
internal.writeExistingMoves: A deposit of {{amount}} {{symbol}} dated {{date}} is recorded there, and its balance goes from {{balance}} up by {{amount}} {{symbol}}. Nothing syncs that account, so nobody else would ever put the money in — you do not need to change it yourself.

split.trigger: It was more than one of these

split.oneLinkOnly: Only one part can move somewhere Scani tracks — {{paired}} or {{internal}}, not both. Cost basis follows one destination, and two would send it to neither.
split.needTwo: Give at least two of these an amount. Together they have to come to {{amount}} {{symbol}}.

clause.paired: {{amount}} keeps what you paid for it as it moves to {{location}}
clause.internal: {{amount}} moves to {{location}}, where a deposit of {{amount}} is recorded
clause.internalFallback: {{amount}} moves to the holding you picked
clause.leftControl: {{amount}} is counted as a disposal at market value on {{date}}
clause.untracked: {{amount}} is still yours, somewhere Scani cannot see

split.summary: {{clauses}}. Only the disposal books a gain.

split.balanceMoves: That account’s balance goes up by the amount that arrived there.

answered.paired: Linked to a deposit — nothing realized
answered.internal: Moved to a holding you track — deposit recorded

reopen.internal: The deposit this recorded on the other account is deleted with it — otherwise your next answer would count that money twice. If answering it moved that account's balance, that comes back off too. The transfer rejoins the queue.
reopen.internalCreated: That account tracked none of this token before you answered, so Scani created the holding as well as the deposit. Both are removed — unless something else has been recorded against that holding since, in which case it stays. The transfer rejoins the queue, and no other balance changes.
reopen.leftControl: The gain this booked comes off your realized total until you answer it again, and the transfer rejoins the queue.
reopen.default: The transfer rejoins the queue, and nothing about it is settled until you answer it again.
reopen.declared: This is a transfer you recorded yourself, so undoing it moves both balances back to what they were before it — the account it left goes back up, the account it arrived in goes back down — and removes both entries. It does not rejoin the queue: there is no question left to answer.

consequence.leftControl_other: Counts {{count}} transfers as disposals — about {{amount}} of proceeds against what you paid.

consequence.takesBack_other: That takes about {{amount}} of realized gains back off the {{count}} currently counted as disposals.

consequence.takesBackUnpriced_other: {{count}} of them are currently counted as disposals, and Scani has no price for any of them, so nothing comes off.

consequence.unpriced_other: {{count}} more have no price on their day and book nothing, so the figure is a floor.

consequence.notADisposal: Every transfer to {{key}}, at any amount, leaves this queue and is listed under Destination rules instead. Nothing is written to them: an unanswered transfer books no gain, and taking the rule back brings every one of them straight back here.

consequence.markUnpricedTail_other: {{count}} of them have no price on their day and book nothing.
consequence.markFuture: Nothing is waiting for this destination right now, so nothing is answered today. Every later transfer to it is answered as having left your portfolio, unopened, and books a gain.
consequence.mark_one: Answers {{count}} transfer to this destination as having left your portfolio, booking {{proceeds}} of proceeds. Every later transfer to it is answered the same way, unopened. consequence.markUnpriced_one: {{count}} transfer to this destination is answered as having left your portfolio. None of them has a price on its day, so nothing is booked today. Every later transfer to it is answered the same way, unopened.
consequence.markUnpricedTail_one: {{count}} of them has no price on its day and books nothing.

revokeConsequence.notADisposal_other: {{count}} transfers come back into the queue. Nothing was written to them, so there is nothing to undo.
revokeConsequence.askMe: Transfers to this destination stop carrying your note. They were never answered by the rule, so nothing else changes.
revokeConsequence.markKeep_one: The rule stops answering new transfers to this destination. The {{count}} transfer it already answered stays answered and keeps booking its gain — tick the box above to take it back too.
revokeConsequence.markKeep_other: The rule stops answering new transfers to this destination. The {{count}} transfers it already answered stay answered and keep booking their gains — tick the box above to take them back too.
revokeConsequence.markWithdraw_one: The rule stops answering new transfers, and the {{count}} transfer it answered goes back into the queue unanswered. Its gain stops being booked.
revokeConsequence.markWithdraw_other: The rule stops answering new transfers, and the {{count}} transfers it answered go back into the queue unanswered. Their gains stop being booked.
